column1: # Reference cases for donor perception, protomer enumeration and chelate detection.
# THIS FILE IS THE INTERFACE FOR ADDING TEST CASES.  Add a row, run
# and the whole set is re-checked.  `python -m pytest` runs it too, so a case added here
# becomes a permanent regression guard rather than something that scrolled past once.
# It lives under data/reference/ because that is the one place in data/ that IS tracked
# by git (see NOTES.md) — everything else there is regenerable and deliberately ignored.
# Columns (tab separated; "-" means "do not check this"):
#   name              free text, for the report
#   chelates          yes | no  — does the NEUTRAL molecule present any chelate pocket
#   ring              expected chelate ring size, or -
#   donors            expected donor types in the pocket, "+"-joined and sorted, or -
#   protomers         expected number of DISTINCT protomers, or -
#   note              why this case is here
